hooks.command: SESSION_ID=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty'); COUNTER_FILE="/tmp/.claude-twin-turns-${SESSION_ID}"; COUNT=0; if [ -f "$COUNTER_FILE" ]; then COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE"); fi; COUNT=$((COUNT + 1)); echo "$COUNT" > "$COUNTER_FILE"; if [ $((COUNT % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"10 turns reached — please run: /twin-memory extract current conversation (use a background agent)"}'; else echo '{}'; fi
